answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent passes one prism of checks once, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. An echo of one honest history cannot be cloned to another identity, and the delta between one real record and a thousand copies is the price a farm cannot fake.
